api.auth.what_it_is: Server-side Supabase Auth session bridge and one-owner guard. It accepts a token already issued by Supabase Auth; it does not receive or store passwords.
api.auth.can_do:
- `POST /api/auth/session.create`: verifies the access token with Supabase Auth, requires exact configured `OWNER_EMAIL`, then sets a Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie.
- `GET /api/auth/session.get`: validates the owner cookie, refreshes an expired session when a refresh token is present, and rotates the cookie.
- `POST /api/auth/session.delete`: revokes the remote session when possible and always clears the local cookie.
- Rejects invalid/non-owner identities, cross-origin session creation, malformed/oversized body and incomplete configuration; tokens never appear in JSON responses or logs.
api.auth.limits:
- Password login, signup UI, password reset, OAuth UI and password storage are intentionally not implemented. Supabase Auth owns credential handling.
- Signup remains enabled by Amit's accepted decision; `OWNER_EMAIL` still restricts JARVIS API access to one owner identity.
- Session cookies require HTTPS because they are Secure. There is no separate server-side session table.

api.chat.what_it_is: Server-side authenticated chat endpoints for threads and messages, connecting owner sessions, RLS thread storage, model gateway streaming, and metadata-only event logging.
api.chat.can_do:
- `POST /api/chat/threads.list`: lists owner-scoped threads, newest first.
- `POST /api/chat/threads.create`: creates an owner-scoped thread.
- `POST /api/chat/messages.list`: lists messages in a thread in sequence order.
- `POST /api/chat/messages.send`: accepts an owner chat message and returns stream ticket.
- `POST /api/chat/messages.stream`: opens authenticated Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for response deltas.
- Emits strictly metadata-only events (`chat.thread.created`, `chat.message.created`, `chat.message.started`, `chat.message.delta`, `chat.message.completed`, `chat.message.error`, `chat.attachment.referenced`).
- Bypasses models locally for self-harm/care signals and displays clear "model set nahi" Hindi guidance when model slots are empty.
api.chat.limits:
- No service-role key is ever passed to `createRlsChatThreadStore`; database RLS is always enforced with the owner's access token.
- Raw message content, deltas, transcripts, and storage references are never written to the events table.
- Model provider adapters stream only authenticated SSE frames to the owner.

api.system.what_it_is: Server-side system endpoints for owner/device identity, kill-switch control and durable event intake/history.
api.system.can_do:
- `GET /api/system/kill.get` returns the current state to the owner or a paired device. Missing/unreadable/malformed state returns 503 with all actions treated as blocked.
- `POST /api/system/kill.set` writes state and an activity audit atomically via `set_system_kill`; a device can only set `kill=true`, owner alone can set false.
- Auth accepts the owner HttpOnly session or a paired device Bearer token; device token is pepper-hashed and looked up server-side. Service-role credentials never go to app/phone.
- `POST /api/system/events.emit` validates registered event schemas, requires `idempotency_key`, forces device source on server, checks a database-backed 60/minute owner limit, and persists duplicates idempotently.
- `POST /api/system/events.list` is owner-only and returns bounded, filtered event history.
api.system.limits:
- It does not execute phone commands or turn the kill switch OFF from a device.
- Migration `0005_event_rate_limits.sql` is a new local migration draft and must be applied by Antigravity to the real project before event intake/rate limiting and atomic kill audit work in production.
- The events table remains outside Realtime publication; `realtime=true` is only metadata for event classification. Realtime stays on `phone_commands`, `system_state`, `tasks`, `reminders`.
- Android secure token storage and native kill UI remain the Android squad's client-side responsibility.

api.tasks.what_it_is: One owner-authenticated Vercel function intended to dispatch both `/api/tasks/*` and `/api/reminders/*` actions for S08.
api.tasks.can_do:
- Reuse `readOwnerSession` from `api/auth` and the signed-in owner's bearer token with the Supabase anon key so row-level security remains active.
- Read and mutate existing `public.tasks` and `public.reminders`, and enqueue reminder-fire jobs in the existing owner-scoped `public.jobs` table.
- Return the Today projection consumed by S08 and D2.
- Route every write through `packages/harness` `executePower`, fail-closed kill-switch checks, and a pre-written metadata-only decision intent.
api.tasks.limits:
- This becomes function 12 of 12 on the supplied Vercel Hobby deployment baseline (11 already used + this one). No squad may add another `api/` function file; all future API routes/features must reuse this function or an already-existing function. Both public route groups need LEAD/S00 rewrites to this handler.
- Does not use a service-role key, edit `packages/contracts`, bypass RLS, or invent/register powers.
- Mutations are expected to stay blocked until S00 accepts the contract and rewrites, S22 registers powers, and Antigravity applies the 0060 migration.
- Medicine/T2 content cannot be persisted without S19 private-vault encryption; accepted S09 hand-offs currently return a safe conflict response.

features.core-workspace.boards.can_do:

- Link eligible existing owner tasks to boards, move a link between columns, unlink a task, and delete a board.
- Show safe task titles/status metadata; private task text is represented as a generic `Private task` badge and is never copied into board metadata or audit logs.
- Reject private/secret board names and column labels using S05's shared S08/S09 privacy projection.
- Enforce owner session + bearer + anon-key RLS, S22 power gates, explicit L2 confirmation, fail-closed kill-switch reads, and metadata-only activity logging.
features.core-workspace.boards.limits:
- Does not create duplicate tasks, edit task body/title/status, or copy task text into board tables.
- Does not process attachments, notes, memory, or private content with any model.
- Does not bypass RLS; missing powers, ON/unreadable kill switch, or unavailable audit intent blocks mutations.
- Mutations remain blocked at L0/L1; S22 must explicitly raise a registered power before an action can execute.

packages.brain.what_it_is: S22 policy for how JARVIS thinks and uses powers. It decides; it does not execute. Enforcement = harness/permissions. Kill switch + audit = safety/.
packages.brain.can_do:
- levels.ts: L0-L4 only. (L0 observe, L1 suggest, L2 act after confirm, L3 act then tell, L4 silent safe+reversible)
- power-registry.ts: validates powers (same rules as DB: id pattern, current<=max, dangerous<=L2, L4 only reversible). newPlugPower() makes a safe new power starting at L0.
- gate.ts: the one gate. Kill ON/unreadable => deny. Unknown power => deny. Otherwise returns mode (observe/suggest/ask_confirm/act_then_tell/act_silent).
- depth-router.ts: FAST / NORMAL / DEEP by rules (no model call), with tunable budgets.
- confirm-wording.ts: wording per level; voice yes only "हाँ / कर दो / भेज दो"; silence never yes; money/health/password confirm by phone voice; money/health/password/vault = voice yes, then owner fingerprint.
- owner-credential.ts: owner fingerprint policy (enrol once in owner login, never deleted, extra ones need owner verify).
- loop.ts: the standard loop with ports; web/screen/message text is data and never starts an action; kill re-checked just before acting.
packages.brain.limits:
- Does not run any power itself. Does not read the kill switch itself (safety/ does; brain only receives the state).
- Planner, uncertainty, proactivity, explainability, contracts and 20+ QA scenarios are bundle 2 (not built).
- Depth budgets are starting values, to tune with S07/S13.
- A new squad MUST call gate() before acting; brain cannot force it. Harness/permissions enforces.

packages.events.what_it_is: JARVIS का strict event envelope, registry, offline outbox और database persistence adapter. हर event एक validated envelope में जाता है।
packages.events.can_do:
- Envelope में `id`, dot.case `type`, `source`, UTC `ts`, object `payload`, optional `correlation_id`, version और server intake के लिए required `idempotency_key` होता है। Payload 16 KB से छोटा होना चाहिए।
- Registry unapproved type और malformed payload reject करती है। S21 के छह approved voice/persona events metadata-only और stored-only हैं।
- `EventOutbox` idempotency key के साथ enqueue करता है, insertion order में flush करता है और failed/network/429/5xx send पर event को queue में रखता है। Browser IndexedDB adapter उपलब्ध है; Android समान `OutboxStore` contract लागू कर सकता है।
- Supabase adapter `events` में owner-scoped idempotent insert/list करता है। Event intake 60/minute/owner database RPC limit जाँचता है; RPC unavailable हो तो write fail-closed है।
- `events` table Realtime publication में नहीं है। Live classified events भी event history में लिखते हैं; phone/app live updates अपनी चार allowed tables से लेते हैं।
packages.events.limits:
- Browser IndexedDB adapter है; native Android Room/SQLite adapter अभी Android squad का काम है।
- Production event writes/rate limit के लिए migration `0005_event_rate_limits.sql` Antigravity को real Supabase पर apply करनी होगी; इस bundle ने remote DB नहीं छुआ।

- `createGateway({...}).call(request)` -> `{ok:true,text,usage,warning?}` या `{ok:false,code,message}`। Codes: `kill_switch_on`, `unknown_model`, `unknown_provider`, `unpriced_model`, `budget_exceeded`, `no_key`, `provider_error`, `timeout`। (built)
